nodes.description: Ownership address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender at deployment and updated in acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address written by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Token symbol string, set to TPS in the TPSToken constructor.
Token name string, set to TRUSTPAY SHARE in the TPSToken constructor.
Token decimals, set to 0; used as exponent base in total supply computation.
Fixed token supply assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
mapping(address => uint) of token balances used by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf and the constructor.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of allowances used by approve, approveAndCall, transferFrom and allowance.
SafeMath.add(uint a, uint b): performs addition with an overflow require check.
SafeMath.sub(uint a, uint b): performs subtraction with an underflow require check.
SafeMath.mul(uint a, uint b): performs multiplication with a division-based overflow check.
SafeMath.div(uint a, uint b): performs division with a non-zero divisor require check.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner), onlyOwner: stages a new owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred, moves owner and clears newOwner.
TPSToken constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints fixed _totalSupply to owner and emits Transfer.
totalSupply(): view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): view returning balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender, credits to, emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits from, decrements allowance of msg.sender, credits to.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval, an external callback.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens), onlyOwner: forwards an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens to owner.
msg.sender used in the Owned constructor to initialise the privileged owner account.
msg.sender compared against owner in the onlyOwner modifier access gate.
msg.sender required to equal newOwner when claiming ownership.
msg.sender whose balance is debited in transfer().
msg.sender whose allowance entry is written in approve().
msg.sender used as the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom().
msg.sender whose allowance entry is written in approveAndCall().
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) with a caller-supplied spender address.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary token contract.
Raw addition a + b inside SafeMath.add; correctness depends solely on the require(c >= a) check.
Raw multiplication a * b inside SafeMath.mul; correctness depends solely on the division-based require check.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the privileged owner state variable directly from msg.sender.
The onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied _newOwner into the pending owner slot.
acceptOwnership validates msg.sender against newOwner before granting ownership.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the ownership claim check.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner back to address(0).
Constructor computes the fixed supply via exponentiation on decimals and writes _totalSupply.
Constructor mints the whole supply to balances[owner].
Constructor writes the initial supply into the balances mapping.
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply() subtracts balances[address(0)] using SafeMath.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried account.
transfer debits the caller's own balance identified by msg.sender.
transfer updates sender and recipient entries of the balances mapping.
transfer delegates balance arithmetic to SafeMath.sub/add.
approve writes the allowance keyed by the caller msg.sender.
approve writes the allowed mapping entry for msg.sender and spender.
transferFrom consumes the allowance of msg.sender acting as spender.
transferFrom debits from and credits to in the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance entry.
allowance reads the allowed mapping for tokenOwner and spender.
approveAndCall writes the allowance keyed by the caller msg.sender.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before calling out.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the caller-supplied spender contract.
The callee of receiveApproval can reenter the token contract before approveAndCall returns.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary token contract address.
Only the owner can reach transferAnyERC20Token through the onlyOwner modifier.
The outcome of the external ERC20 transfer is routed to the owner address.
SafeMath.add's raw a + b depends entirely on the require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath.mul's raw a * b depends entirely on the require(a == 0 || c / a == b) guard.
Parameter a is consumed by the addition in SafeMath.add.
Parameter b is consumed by the addition in SafeMath.add.
Local c stores the unchecked sum produced inside SafeMath.add.
Parameter a is consumed by the subtraction in SafeMath.sub.
Parameter b is consumed by the underflow check in SafeMath.sub.
Local c stores the difference produced inside SafeMath.sub.
Parameter a is consumed by the multiplication in SafeMath.mul.
Parameter b is consumed by the multiplication in SafeMath.mul.
Local c stores the product produced inside SafeMath.mul.
Parameter a is the dividend in SafeMath.div.
Parameter b is the divisor validated as non-zero in SafeMath.div.
Local c stores the quotient produced inside SafeMath.div.
Parameter _newOwner becomes the pending owner in transferOwnership.
Parameter tokenOwner is the lookup key in balanceOf.
Parameter to is the credited account in transfer.
Parameter tokens is the amount subtracted from the sender in transfer.
Parameter spender keys the allowance written by approve.
Parameter tokens is the allowance value stored by approve.
Parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens drives both the balance debit and the allowance decrement.
Parameter tokenOwner is the first lookup key in allowance.
Parameter spender is the second lookup key in allowance.
Parameter spender is both the allowance key and the target contract of the external call in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens sets the allowance and is forwarded to receiveApproval.
Parameter data is opaque bytes forwarded verbatim to the callee contract.
Parameter tokenAddress selects the arbitrary contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter tokens is forwarded to the external token transfer call.
